name: CB Financial Services, Inc.
summary: CB Financial Services, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Community Bank that provides banking products and services for individuals and businesses. Its primary deposit products include demand deposits, NOW accounts, money market accounts, and savings and checking accounts, as well as time deposit products.
